title: The land e2e scenario uses a fixture backlog, so an invalid live backlog item cannot fail the suite
goal: _tools/test_land_e2e.py's scenarios build their kb/_self/backlog/ from fixture items instead of copying the live backlog, so a planning slip in a live item (a story with no checks) no longer fails backlog.py check inside the scenario and the land e2e test with it. Answers the SP-caqrexqw close: the review story's tests.py check refused because three just-filed parked stories lacked checks.
notes: Planned at the 2026-10-10 whole-backlog triage, which the operator asked to end with every draft planned into a sprint or dropped (sprint 9 of 13, "Test suite and tools docs fixes"); the triage reviewer found it serves the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test F3: a sprint review files its gaps as parked drafts.
